title: Extension storage: local, sync, session and their quotas
when: A browser extension stores settings or user data and must choose between local, sync and session storage while staying inside their limits.
inputs: needs to follow the user across devices
prompt:
Goal: Data in the right storage area, writes within quota and rate limits, a schema version with migration, and every part reacting to changes.
Steps:
1. storage.sync for small settings that follow the user: about 100 KB total, 8 KB per item, 512 items, plus per minute and per hour write limits.
2. storage.local for larger data (about 10 MB; "unlimitedStorage" only if truly needed); storage.session for in memory values that outlive worker restarts but not a browser restart.
3. Declare "storage"; read with defaults: await chrome.storage.sync.get({ theme: "auto", sites: [] }).
4. Store settings in a few keys and debounce text input writes by 500 ms.
5. Before a sync write compare getBytesInUse() with chrome.storage.sync.QUOTA_BYTES; move large parts to local and keep a pointer in sync.
6. Catch write rejections (per item quota, rate limits) and tell the user.
7. Keep schemaVersion; in runtime.onInstalled with reason "update" migrate old keys, then save the new version.
8. storage.onChanged keeps popup, options and content scripts in sync.
Quality bar:
- Settings survive worker and browser restarts.
- No tokens in sync storage.
- Migrations are idempotent.
Pitfalls:
- localStorage in the worker (absent) or in content scripts (it belongs to the site).
- A growing list in sync that hits the per item limit.
Verify:
- [ ] storage permission declared.
- [ ] Reads pass defaults.
- [ ] Write errors caught.
- [ ] Migration keyed on schemaVersion.
Output: storage.js with get, set and migrate helpers, used by background.js and the UI pages.

examples.input: onde guardar a lista de sites bloqueados da minha extensao
examples.output: storage.js: settings in sync with byte check, large list in local, schemaVersion migration on update, onChanged listeners
